mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.25% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by > 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in unemployment rate indicates a weakening economy, which leads to lower consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rose > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts signals a strengthening economy and increased consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST showed a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production indicates a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declined > 2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising real estate activity (HOUST) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increased > 5% and UNRATE decreased > 0.3% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL < 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market and increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS showed a sharp increase.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increased > 5% YoY.
